## Tickets

### POLISH-015: Publish the image on a GitHub Release

**Status**

Complete on 2026-10-28. `.github/workflows/release.yml` builds the
`Dockerfile` on a published GitHub Release and pushes
`ghcr.io/ridloncmr/krazitv:<tag>`, plus `:latest` for a full release; CI is
unchanged. `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` is hand-maintained, so the workflow's
comment says to update it before a release, and the first pre-release tag
still has to verify the published image on a clean machine.

**Goal**: A first-time user pulls kraziTV instead of building it (decision 6).

**Scope**: A `release.yml` workflow that, on a published GitHub Release,
builds the existing `Dockerfile` and pushes `ghcr.io/ridloncmr/krazitv:<tag>`
and `:latest`. `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` is regenerated in the same release.

**Out of scope**: Multi-architecture images beyond what the base image gives
for free; signing.

**Blocking dependencies**: None. Blocks POLISH-016's quick start.

**Implementation notes**: Use `docker/login-action` with `GITHUB_TOKEN` and
`packages: write`. Keep CI's build job as the pull-request check.

**Verification**: A pre-release tag publishes an image; `docker pull` and the
README run command start kraziTV on a clean machine and show the logon screen.

**Docs impact**: README quick start (POLISH-016); ADR 0019 unchanged.

### POLISH-019: Decide the count rule and bring the exceptions up to date

**Status**

Complete on 2026-10-28. Kind folders are exempt from both grouping counts
and the nesting limit, recorded in ADR 0010 and `AGENTS.md` and checked by
`layout-rules.mjs`; migrations are left out of the copy scan through
`duplicateCodeExcludedPaths`, and the exceptions file lost its eleven
migration pairs, five kind-folder entries, and the drawings nesting entry,
gained `apps/web/src/tv/`, and had its stale reasons rewritten. Regrouping
`controls/` and `channels/assignments/` stays with POLISH-020.

**Goal**: The audit's more-than-eight rule has one recorded answer for kind
folders, and every exception's reason is true (decision 5).

**Scope**: Amend ADR 0010 and the `AGENTS.md` grouping bullet to say whether
kind folders (`schema/`, `migrations/`, `drawings/`, `http/contracts/`) are
exempt from the count; implement that in `layout-rules.mjs`; add an
`excludedPaths` entry for `apps/server/src/database/migrations/` to the
duplicate-code rule and remove the eleven migration pair exceptions it covers;
add the `apps/web/src/tv/` grouping exception; rewrite the reasons of the
`grouping` exceptions for `packages/krazi-brain/src/schedule/` (name the six
files and cite `AGENTS.md` instead of the completed plan) and `packages/signal/src/ffmpeg/mpeg-ts/` (name the three files added
since); drop `reservation-routes.ts` from the `duplicate-code` exception that
names the assignment, marathon-settings, and rule routes. Exceptions are
cited here by rule and path because the file has no IDs and positions shift
when entries are removed.

**Out of scope**: Regrouping folders (POLISH-020, POLISH-021) and the
match-choice helper (POLISH-023).

**Blocking dependencies**: None. Blocks POLISH-020.

**Implementation notes**: If kind folders are exempt, the `grouping`
exceptions for `apps/server/src/database/schema/`, `database/migrations/`,
`apps/web/src/http/contracts/`, `apps/web/src/branding/avatars/drawings/`,
and `apps/server/src/programming-assignments/routes/` become unnecessary and
are removed, as does the `nesting-depth` exception for `drawings/`, whose
reason cites the count. The recommended answer: exempt them, since
`AGENTS.md`'s reference tree already draws `schema/` and `migrations/` flat.
ADR 0010's Consequences say the thresholds are "judgment aids, not lint"
while `npm run audit:strict` fails CI on them; reconcile that sentence in the
same amendment.

**Verification**: `npm run audit:strict` passes; `npm run test:audit` covers
the new exclusion and exemption.

**Docs impact**: ADR 0010 amended; `AGENTS.md` bullet.

### POLISH-020: Regroup controls/ and channels/assignments/

**Status**

Complete on 2026-10-29. `controls/` is grouped into `formatting/`,
`selection/`, `dialogs/`, `popups/`, and one folder per standalone control
(`pager/`, `tabbed-panel/`, `checkbox-option/`, `segmented-progress-bar/`,
and by judgment `setting-location/`, added by POLISH-014), and
`channels/assignments/` became `channels/stretch/`,
`channels/collection-preview/`, and `channels/members/`, which by judgment
also holds `play-order-field.tsx` and `playback-mode-choices.ts`. Both
exceptions are gone, and `formatting/`'s seven one-capability files record a
flat-folder exception.

**Goal**: The two folders past the hard count read as their capabilities and
their exceptions go away.

**Scope**: `apps/web/src/controls/` into `formatting/` (display-count,
display-duration, display-time, local-instant, file-name, channel-number,
form-text), `selection/` (id-selection, row-click, use-range-toggle),
`dialogs/` (window-dialog, window-status, request-feedback, blocking-specials),
`popups/` (row-menu, tooltip, use-popup-dismissal), and folders named for
what they are for the remaining four (pager, tabbed-panel, checkbox-option,
segmented-progress-bar); never a catch-all name. `controls.css` stays at the
domain root as its stylesheet. `apps/web/src/channels/assignments/` into
`stretch/`, `collection-preview/` (not `preview/`, which `channels/preview/`
already uses), and `members/`. Remove the two `grouping` exceptions.

**Out of scope**: Behavior.

**Blocking dependencies**: POLISH-019.

**Implementation notes**: Pure moves plus import updates; `npm run typecheck`
finds every import. Land before POLISH-006 or after, never during.

**Verification**: `npm run audit:strict`, `npm test` for the web workspace.

**Docs impact**: Spec 0008 names `channels/` folders; update its list.

### POLISH-021: Signal session release helper and ProcessBinding

**Status**

Complete on 2026-10-29. `ProcessBinding` in
`packaging/session/process-binding.ts` owns each process's readiness timer,
stall timer, and usable-output flag, and its `release(onStopFailure)` replaces
the four stop sequences; it also reports `onExited`, so the session forgets
ended processes. `packaging/` is grouped into `arguments/` and `session/` with
its exceptions rewritten, and `PreparationOwner` is dropped for
`import type { FfmpegSignalSession }`.

**Goal**: `FfmpegSignalSession` reads as its transitions and the audit's
file-size review item closes.

**Scope**: One `release(binding, onStopFailure)` replacing the four copies of
cancel readiness, detach, discard, stop; a `ProcessBinding` class in
`packaging/process-binding.ts` owning the readiness timer, stall timer, and
usable-output flag, built with `onReady`, `onFailed`, `onStalled`; the session
keeps every decision that reads `active`, `suspended`, or `stopping`. Then
group `packaging/` into `arguments/` and `session/` and rewrite or remove its
`grouping` exception.
Decide `PreparationOwner`: drop it for `import type { FfmpegSignalSession }`,
or keep it with a comment saying why.

**Out of scope**: Any change to what airs, when, or the ADR 0020 stand-in
policy.

**Blocking dependencies**: POLISH-019 (grouping answer).

**Implementation notes**: The three failure policies become the one
`onStopFailure` argument. Keep the fake packager's contract tests green
first; they are the double-fidelity check.

**Verification**: `npm test` for signal; `npm run test:ffmpeg`; `npm run
audit:strict` shows no file-size review item.

**Docs impact**: None; ADR 0016 and 0020 unchanged.
